title: Alumni Tracker - Class of 2005
content: This section includes comprehensive demographic details of the Class of 2005 alumni, including current addresses, marital status, employment history, and recent achievements. Emily Johnson has published her second novel, which has been shortlisted for a national literary award. Jennifer Walters lives at 55 Crystal Lake Avenue, is single, and is a practicing attorney at Goodman, Lieber, Kurtzberg & Holliway. Upcoming events: The annual Oakwood Charity Gala is scheduled for June 15th, where several alumni will be honored for their philanthropic efforts.
